title: Best Attacks on Hybrid AES-Like Schemes
summary: For hybrid AES-like schemes spanning different round counts and key sizes, identifying the best attacks for each resulting parameter combination remains open.

formal_statement.body: For hybrid AES-like schemes that combine varying numbers of rounds with varying key sizes, determine the best cryptanalytic attacks for the resulting parameter combinations.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key cryptanalysis of hybrid AES-like block-cipher schemes.
parameters: Number of rounds: varied round configuration
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the best cryptanalytic attacks for the resulting combinations of round counts and key sizes.

citations.label: Key Recovery Attacks of Practical Complexity on AES-256 Variants with up to 10 Rounds

progress.summary: The paper presents this as the first item in its explicit list of main open problems, asking for the best attacks on hybrid AES-like schemes with different round counts and key sizes.
citation_labels: Alex Biryukov et al., Key Recovery Attacks of Practical Complexity on AES-256 Variants with up to 10 Rounds
